0be308cb-4508-4daf-98ef-9fc53ced79b8.quote: Best player in the lobby, and it was not close. Drongo treated Kira like a respawn timer with legs, killing her six times and Ikra five, and our duo did not lose a body early while theirs lost three. That is the standard, not a lucky night. His one death came to Greystone in the final fight, so when Greystone commits onto him, Drongo backs toward Steel and fights from behind him.

66b1d403-af84-4f1c-bf87-57e0c41df0ba.quote: Soulbearer is a mage crest. Its magical power, mana and magical lifesteal do little for a physical bruiser; the shield and movement speed are the parts Zarus uses. Brutallax, a fighter crest, trades those for physical power, health and omnivamp, plus a cleanse and tenacity that basic attacks extend, which answers Aurora's root-and-stun chain directly.

In the opening minutes, when Kwang has not shown on the map, Phase plays back from the wave and saves Phase Blink for the exit.
